case_number: 2023 INSC 817; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.377 OF 2007; CRL. APPEAL NO. 2763/2023
summary: Constitutionality of DSPE Act Sec.6A(1); retrospective application of Subramanian Swamy judgment; Article 20 protection against retrospective penalties; immunity for Joint Secretary and above; investigation without prior approval void; High Court judgment vacated; prosecution reinstated post-constitutional invalidity.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1942 s.6A(1)
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(2), s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Article 20 bars retrospective application; prosecution permitted to proceed after Subramanian Swamy declaration.
